name: zfmv_action_play_avi_begin
description: zFMV_ActionPlayAvi::Begin allocates and initializes a zFMV_Stream, captures the active render-region rectangle, and arms the Update first-frame latch.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV PlayAvi/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463790 validates the thiscall Begin contract: allocate 0x1e4 bytes for zFMV_Stream, initialize it with mediaPath and modeFlags when allocation succeeds, store the resulting stream pointer, zero destRect.left and destRect.top, fill destRect.right and destRect.bottom from zRndr::GetActiveRegionState, and set lastDecodedFrameIndex to -1.

The dependency frontier has no source blockers: zFMV_Stream::Init and zRndr::GetActiveRegionState are accepted for the functional lane, operator new is a CRT provider, and compiler EH glue is provider-boundary.
The native smoke verifies stream allocation/initialization presence, active-region rectangle capture, and the lastDecodedFrameIndex first-update sentinel.
